limits: Relationship coverage: 99.5% of the 5,412 corporate borrowers have a supplier or customer link in rel-saudi-v1; supplier links are observed only through payments routed via the bank, so a counterparty banking elsewhere is not seen.
A book-wide macro move reaches every borrower through its sector's cycle beta; supplier links are not added on top (they are already in the sector betas).
Retail customers employed by the hit corporates are counted, not stressed: the retail book is not in this run.
The relationship manager on each call is from the Branches and RMs domain at the quarter.
